cc:Work.dc:title: Second Stage Average History
cc:Work.dc:description: The earlier two-source import-inclusive B2 history is preserved separately from the broader 23-source prepared checked compilation series. Compile-only circles and including-import dashed diamonds show distinct timing boundaries. Changed TypeScript reference commits break the line. Fresh P65 and P66 measurements use the same new reference. Latest compile-only mean: 1.321100x. Qualified B2 is not installed.
